newsitem.title: USA: ProSource Distribution in leasing contract.
newsitem.headline: ProSource Distribution in leasing contract.

text.p: ProSource Distribution Services said on Friday that it had signed a six-year contract with privately held Penske Truck Leasing, a transportation services company, for leasing and contract maintenance operations.
Prosource, a food and service supplier to chain restaurants, did not release terms of the contract.
However, the company said the agreement should create savings on ProSource fleet-leasing and maintenance operational costs.
"By 1998, nearly half our national fleet will be brand new, which will improve both fuel efficiency and service reliability," said Prosource president Thomas Highland.
